item.title: a small guide to container images
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
Short post: container images is one of those things that looks simple until it isn’t.

why it matters

Container images shows up across devops work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.
  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
